environment.description: Same Rails 7.1 application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Split.io SDK configured with workspace-level kill switch: the split definition for 'xml-import-legacy-parser' has been archived and the SDK default treatment is set to 'off' in the YAML fallback file mounted at /etc/split/localhost.yaml (Split SDK runs in localhost mode with no external sync). The SDK localhost mode file contains: 'xml-import-legacy-parser: off'. Note: the application code still references all three parser paths and the Nokogiri DTD/noent configuration remains in source. The container image includes libxml2 2.12.4 but this is not the primary control. Split SDK v8.3.0 in localhost mode reads treatments exclusively from the mounted YAML and ignores any targeting rules or dynamic updates.

config.network: outbound restricted to VPC endpoints and specific webhook IPs via security group
config.load_balancer: ALB with default rules only (no WAF)
